correctness.rationale: The Babson–Kozlov wedge theorem gives concentration in degree d=n-3, with reduced rank 2^n-3 by signed ordered-partition enumeration (including the six-point case n=3). No relative interior can be stabilized by rotating the three nonempty disjoint source sets, so oriented cells in each orbit supply a free group-ring summand by orienting one representative and transporting. The augmented cellular exact sequence ends in the trivial module and gives H_d stably the (d+1)-st syzygy by Schanuel; the alternating g-1 and norm resolution gives I for even d, Z for odd d. The integral C_3 lattice classification gives the three indecomposable types Z,I,R; mod three their blocks have sizes 1,2,3. Free stabilization changes only the size-three count, so this classification and the integral rank determine the given actual lattice. Independently built signed cellular matrices confirm the Jordan data for n=4–7. For n>=5, the free cover is universal; the classifying map has the (d-1)-connected fiber X_n. Its integral homology agrees with that of BC_3 below d; the quotient has free top homology because there are no higher cells, and its Euler characteristic is chi(X_n)/3. The mod-three classifying map is an isomorphism below d and injective in d, since there is no lower nonzero fiber row that could alter these degrees. UCT gives the claimed dimension of the top complement; products involving it in positive degree vanish. For the cup-length upper bound, use that H^1 is one-dimensional and its generator squares to zero: an L-fold nonzero product needs degree at least 2L-1. The stated polynomial and polynomial-exterior monomials attain the bound. These checks preserve the scope n>=3 for the lattice and n>=5 for the quotient.
residual_risks: No canonical cycle basis or homotopy classification of the quotient is asserted. The modular calculation supports the signed action but is not a proof of the integral result or the cohomology ring.

value.rationale: Source rotation is a canonical action on the graph-Hom family. The result decides the nonfree summand of its integral lattice in every dimension, an obstruction invisible in the rational representation, and identifies all ordinary quotient products and the Bockstein rather than only a rank or a lower bound on cup-length. These exact equivariant and multiplicative invariants give usable comparisons with genuinely different target quotients and clarify the role of freeness. The value is this structural application, not a new general method of integral representation theory.
residual_risks: No claim about larger source permutation groups or unstable quotient homotopy is supported.
